title: Gaussian conditional slope identity
statement: For every real number $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$, define the Gaussian conditional slope by $c(\rho)=(1-\rho)/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$. Then $\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,c(\rho)=1-\rho$.
